title: STUN traversal
desc: Reach internal services from outside on NAT1 (full-cone) networks without a public IP
intro: Keeps a mapping on the channel port and obtains the public address via STUN; external traffic reaches the internal service through the built-in forwarder. The public port is assigned by the ISP, and Webhooks and scripts are triggered when it changes.
empty: No rules yet. Add one, or import a Lucky config in "Settings → Backup & Migration"
ruleNamePlaceholder: The name is passed to Webhooks and scripts as the ruleName variable
localPortHelp: 0 means random. If the main router is not this machine, forward this port to this machine on the router (or enable UPnP)
disableForwardHelp: The router forwards the channel port straight to the target for better performance, but the channel port must be fixed
targetAddrPlaceholder: e.g. 192.168.1.10; separate multiple addresses with commas (failover in order)
bindHelp: Keep the default unless you use multiple WAN lines or dial-ups
ipRulePlaceholder: Empty picks the 1st; a number n picks the n-th; 24* prefix; *24 suffix; or a regex
stunServersPlaceholder: One host:port per line; TCP traversal requires servers that support TCP
keepAlivePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the global setting; one host:port per line (HTTP)
localHostIpPlaceholder: Enter the host IP for Docker bridge networks; otherwise leave empty
controlUrlPlaceholder: Fill in only if auto-discovery fails; otherwise leave empty
natpmpGatewayPlaceholder: Router IP; leave empty to use the UPnP gateway IP
internalPortHelp: 0 maps to the channel port; if set, the router forwards directly to this port on this machine
disableCheckHelp: The check connects to its own public address to confirm reachability
onlyOnChange: Notify only when the address changes
scriptHelp: Executed with sh -c; variables are passed as environment variables: {vars} (GATELY_-prefixed versions are also provided)
ipAccessNote: Applies to the built-in forwarding only; STUN queries and the channel check are unaffected. Editing the list does not redo the traversal, so the public port stays the same; UDP is checked per packet.
